notes.title: Frosted Fears: What's Next?
notes.content:
[h3]Man, where do I even start here?[/h3]

First of all, it's been a beautiful year for me as a developer.

From the continued success of Happy Bones I and Happy Bones Infernal, to my newest full-length
game release this year, 'Waking Atlas'! 
Y'all have poured out your love, support, and coin in order to keep pushing me to do what I do, and I appreciate the HECK out of that.

Let's take a look at some of the big achievements!

Happy Bones I hit over 500 players worldwide, which is crazy to me!
Looking back at this dinky project that I started back in 2016, it's wild to see where it's gone.

Happy Bones Infernal sold [u]THREE TIMES[/u] as many copies this year than it did last year when it launched, for a total of nearly 300 copies to date. This probably means the most to me, as while I love the narrative story of that game, I do regret doing the game in 3D vs.. the hand-drawn style that made so many people love the first game. (You live and learn I guess)
Overall, I'm glad to see that this entry is seeing a resurgence of sorts.

Waking Atlas became my [i]fastest[/i] selling game to date, which also took me by surprise as the only other game made with GB Studio at the time on Steam was a game called Dragonborne, which literally got negative reviewed into oblivion, the dated mechanics and graphical style being cited as the culprit. (It got so much dislike they actually ended up unlisting it from the Steam store)
My worries ended up being unfounded, as it sold twice as many copies on launch day than Happy Bones I did on it's respective launch day in 2021, and you all showered (mostly) praise upon my inbox!

Then there was Captain Cone!
*crickets* *crickets*
Don't worry, his time to shine will come eventually.

[h3]So where are we going from here?[/h3]

If you follow me on Twitter (X?) you know that I announced that I was remaking Happy Bones I in HD, I did a silly teaser trailer for it and it was a grand time! You can see that teaser [url=https://x.com/FrostedFears/status/1671215102349934595?s=20]here[/url] if you're interested!

It's still in development despite the Unity fiasco.

[i]OMG BUT FROSTEDFEARS WHY ARE YOU REMAKING THAT?! IT JUST CAME OUT TWO YEARS AGO![/i]

Well, for starts, it won't be releasing for a while. So by the time I'm projecting to actually launch it, it'll be more like 5 years since the original came out.

Secondly, there are features that I wanted to add to the original, that I simply can't because of how I developed it. I never thought about adding major features when I made the original, it was just a hobby project for years. Therefore making it from the ground up but prettier, *chefs kiss*.

Lastly, I want to be able to reach the console audience, those guys deserve weird RPGs too!
Porting RPG Maker MV games to modern consoles is a convoluted process, and the porting services are simply too expensive when I can just remake the game but better, ya know?

[h3]Where else are we going?[/h3]

Lots of places...just not for a while.

I don't want to come off like I'm crying on the internet here but bear with me.

Ever since I released HB1 I've been plagued with a pattern of mobility related health problems. I had a motorcycle accident in May of 2021, which lead to be being unable to walk for several months, and I wasn't able to truly walk normally again until the later months of 2022.

Flash forward to 2023, in March (several days after finishing development on Waking Atlas) I woke up with an awful deblitating lower back and leg pain. 

Turns out I'd herniated a disc and it's since been causing me movement deficits and just awful pain all the time.

Presently, I'm seeing a spine specialist, doing considerably better, and the end of my (sorry to sound dramatic) suffering is in sight.

With that, I've been thinking of all the things I can't wait to do, all the things I've missed out on the last few years. I'm an outdoorsy person, and I can't wait to go all the places I've been wanting to go, go do all the hikes I've been wanting to hike.

Naturally, my mind isn't on working on my games right now, there's just other things I'd rather do now that I'm able to again. I've sat in front of a computer screen every day and I just need a break :(

I've released a game every year since starting, but this is the year I'll most likely break that trend.

This isn't goodbye so much as it is a [i]see you later, alligator![/i]

Thank you all so much for you support, and I sincerely hope I have it when I return, whenever that is.

For now, I'll leave you some completely wild screenshots of some things I've been working on, and you can probably look forward to.

[h2]For now, from the bottom of my heart, thank you for playing.[/h2]

notes.title: Happy Bones: The State of The Game!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everybody![/h1]

Here in about a week and a half,  we'll be coming up on the [i] TWO-YEAR ANNIVERSARY[/i] of Happy Bones! 
It certainly feels like it's been longer than that for me, but hey, that's exciting!

I do not have an event planned, but I DO have another game releasing

That means it's been two years with you lovely bunch!

[h2]ALL RIGHT LET'S  TALK BUSINESS![/h2]

Let me get the kind of bad news out of the way first:

Happy Bones Infernal ACT 2 has been canceled...sort of.

The story will still be told but I've decided to revert any future mainline Happy Bones games to a hand-drawn art style. 
There was too much content in Act 2 and too much planned that it just didn't feel right putting it after such an epic main story.

Infernal will still receive an update with an extended ending, however.

I've been exploring many ways to tell it, and for a while I had something pretty cool going.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/8c5158e25f47e65b9fba0d967d6d29546147c061.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/f67c3cb5c59d3f8b9cf8b430c5cad6973ccee4d9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/7bb07f731821ada6fa172052b9010981a60d1186.gif[/img]

So what you see in those GIFs is a little bit of early footage of a 'Happy Bones' online RPG that I had in development for a bit. It featured the same hand-drawn art style as the first game and saw the player take control of an alpha human some years after the events of Infernal, essentially playing out the story of ACT 2.
Players were able to really create their unique character in the Happy Bones art style, and choose one of the three original classes (Brave, Holy, Occult). 
There were world events, animated attacks, etc.
Sadly, I've moved on from this project for now, but it was fun and I'm not opposed to returning to it in the future.
I'll figure out something in regard to the proper continuation of Infernal.

Once RPG Maker Unite comes out I'd like to start on a Happy Bones 2 (proper). This wouldn't be a direct sequel, think the Final Fantasy games, similar themes, new characters, self-contained.

In other news...

My newest game, WAKING ATLAS is coming out Apr 20th of this month over on itch.io, it'll be free to play in a browser, and able to be downloaded in Gameboy, PC, and Pocket formats for a small $2.99 fee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/7d51737c744b7248d97a2eb4075f51e8f955586c.png[/img]


I don't want to spoil anything major in regards to the story of the game, but I will say that if you've enjoyed the Happy Bones series' so far...

[u]You absolutely do NOT want to miss this one.[/u]

Play it, I [u]promise[/u] the pay-off will be worth it for you! ;)

You can follow it over [url=https://frostedfears.itch.io/wakingatlas]HERE![/url]

Go play the Happy Bones Browser Version while you're there!

[h2]Happy Bones 1 Final Update?[/h2]

It's coming, don't you worry.
I wanted  to release it on the 2 Year Anniversary but that isn't going to happen.
I'm dedicated to making it as CHONKY as possible because after that I'm going to be DONE DONE with the updates for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/fcf423dbf84478edc20cefb1db099cace71be227.png[/img]

You're still getting that summoner class!


Well, that's really it!

Talk to me, what do y'all want to see?

Thoughts? Feelings? You know I want to hear it all!


[h2]As always, much love!

And Thank You For Playing!

-FrostedFears[/h2]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.3 & WHAT'S TO COME!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everybody![/h2]
[h3]Thank you for your patience![/h3]

[h3]Update 1.3 is finally here![/h3]
It will be hitting Steam as an update this evening.

Let's talk about what you can expect:

[h3]1. A Redone Character Select Screen![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/6ce895aed8b9576c9dd4988fb10c31c2c378af43.png[/img]

[h3]2. Character Portraits in battle![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/917097eccf8ce219dac0ae5d75a83d1ad9ad056a.png[/img]

[h3]3. TWO NEW QUESTS![/h3]
-Jazzy's Stamp Collection: Help a depressed clown track down what he desires most, his lost stamps.
You can start this quest anytime from a new door found in the game room in the Cervantes House.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/dd18266dd1046db3f628e00f1b94fae28e426c8c.png[/img]

-The Beast From The Rift: A rift in the lab is unstable, perhaps you could find a stabilizer in the TV station to help out the scientists? You can start this quest late game after completing Gustavo's portion of the main quest, found by accessing a new door in the lab area.
This quest culminates in a hunt for an escaped monster and showdown with one of the hardest bosses in the game, but rewards the player with some of the best armor obtainable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/f6ceb802bdc900f53c53d733d4be76da93568d11.png[/img]

[h3]4. New Boss Cutscenes![/h3]

[h3]5. New Pins Added To The Prize Capsule Pool![/h3]

[h3]6. New Weapons Added To Monster Drops![/h3]

[h3]7. Two New Achievements![/h3]

[h2]So What Comes Next For Happy Bones?[/h2]

So all this being said, the majority of this update that you're not seeing is a framework rework.
I've redone a lot of the variables and switches in order to give me the ability to extend Happy Bones to its fullest capabilities.

This game has the finest community of players and supporters around, and I'm dedicated to making this the best possible experience it can be.

There's many of you who have 100% Completion on this game.

That means you've kept coming back every updated, loaded up your save files, and ventured back into the compound to destroy whatever new demons or adventures I've added.

I appreciate the heck out of that, that's awesome.

[i]So I've decided I want to keep the updates for this game coming.[/i]

[h2]Therefore let's talk about what's coming with Update 1.4[/h2]

First of all, by popular demand...I'm excited to confirm the SIXTH playable class for Happy Bones
by showing you a screenshot of what it looks like in battle currently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/fcf423dbf84478edc20cefb1db099cace71be227.png[/img]

Yeah I know.

Awesome right?

The Sixth Class [h3]'The Whisperer'[/h3] is a culmination of ALL the feedback I've gotten over the last 18 months of this game's lifespan.
The Whisperer is the only class in the game that is able to speak to demons, and is able to win their loyalty over by performing certain tasks.
Therefore it is the only class in the game that will have additional PERMANENT party members, which has been a highly requested feature.

You can even see them following you around outside of battles.
You can even give them cute names (as I have)!

The Whisperer focuses on being able to take care of her team of demons and ensure they are able to take and deal as much damage as possible.

I'll have more details on that class in the near future!

[h3]'What Else?'[/h3]

-More Graphical Improvements!
The new cutscenes are great, and I think I'd like for more of the game to feature visuals such as those that add to the experience.
Additionally I think the new battle UI makes the game feel like a less generic looking RPG, and I'm looking to do the same thing with the menus/inventory.

-A Quest Log
The two new quests in the game are the two highest quality quests in the game, and I'd like to add more, in order to make them as comfortable as possible to keep up with I'll be adding a quest log.


Enjoy the Update.

From the bottom of my heart as always, thank you for playing.

I will have another announcement with more expansion details and screenshots coming soon.

notes.title: Update this Halloween Season!
notes.content:
[h2]Y'all didn't think I'd disappoint for Halloween did you?![/h2]

First things first, sorry I've been quiet on here lately.
Even on my Twitter I haven't spoke much publicly.
I've been working on some other projects and finishing my first novel!
I still care deeply for you all.

So let's talk about this update.

The majority of changes this update brings comes from player feedback so let's start there!

[h3]Improved Class Select Screen![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/6ce895aed8b9576c9dd4988fb10c31c2c378af43.png[/img]

Yeah I know, it's a miracle.
You can now freely browse the class select screen without an annoying pop up box every time you move!
Each scroll gives a brief description of the class you're choosing, and players can simply hit ENTER to choose the class now.

[h3]Enhanced Cutscenes![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/503dac7f1b3808d57429349a4c6579e4eb6cd94e.gif[/img]

A few cutscenes have been expanded to give them some more OOMPH! 

Namely some iconic bosses who deserved better and truly posed a greater threat than their intros gave initially gave off.

[h3]Expanded Areas![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/e6052c15b103a16591b7eca20092695cc8e228f7.png[/img]

A few areas have been slightly expanded offering new NPC's , new tasks, and expanded story...
And of course...

[h3]New Monsters![/h3]

Like...

Flesh Golem!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/1ac710b94b8e6df817463d52d194c624b5bd7b6a.png[/img]
& Dearly Departed!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/5acf3c2365b7737a3d120c3cf8a4fe5683b2f5d9.png[/img]

Additionally there will be a slew of new weapons and pins to collect, like this Shrunken Head!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/1a1ee14b8bcc130ab81f5faae0227c740fdd7e03.png[/img]

Overall, I believe this update provides a nice new layer of paint for those that have already experienced Happy Bones, and a great addition for any newcomers to experience as well!

Thank You all for everything, many of my supporters have been added to the credits out of thanks for all you do whether it's promoting my work or  simply finding bugs and posting them in the forums.

I hope you all enjoy this update when it releases later this October (before Halloween).

Much Love, and as always thank you for playing!

-FrostedFears

notes.title: RPG Maker Festival Special Item Code!
notes.content:
[h2]To celebrate RPG Maker Festival...[/h2]
[h2]Enter the code below into the Gift Machine in the Machine Cave in order to receive a BATTLE RAT![/h2]
[h2]112622[/h2]
[i]Unless you're on Mac, someday guys...someday you'll get that update.[/i]

So Happy Bones is being featured during the RPG Maker Festival Sale this year, and I just think that's the coolest thing, because if I could travel back in time and tell younger me that this would be happening someday he'd probably pee his pants.
[i]I mean, not that he didn't already pee his pants but maybe in excitement?[/i]

In order to elaborate on that I'm going to tell you the story of the first RPG I EVER made.

AND OH WHAT A BEAUTIFUL TRAINWRECK IT WAS!

So let me set the scene here, the year is 2003, I'm in like the sixth grade or something right?
I'm doing my 11 year old thing on the internet one day, probably listening to Green Day and looking around on emulation sites for something to play, trying to cope with the weight of my parents violent divorce and custody battles.

After a bit I find myself on some strange corner of the internet looking at a download link for [i]RPG Maker 2000 by Don Miguele (FREE) [/i].

Accompanying it were all these awesome screenshots of what looked like a legitimate way for an 11 year old to be able to easily make fully customized RPG adventures, I was psyched!

So I downloaded it...

And holy crap, it wasn't a virus.

[i]It was awesome.[/i]

For once I was able to create the game I wanted to create, everything was within my limits!

I played around with the program for weeks learning the ins and the outs, while I was in class at middle school I would be drawing enemies and maps for an RPG I was working on.
Slowly, bit by bit, what I was creating would become the first RPG I ever completed!
It went by the name of...

[h2]Unburied[/h2]

Oh yeah, super edgy sounding.

But it actually wasn't all that hardcore, in fact it was essentially my own take on an [i]Earthbound[/i] styled game, because that's just what I liked to play in those years.

From what I remember of the general plot it went a lot like this:

[i]In the region of Appleland lives a young boy named Karl who has just tragically lost his mother.
Many weeks later his mother comes to him in a vision telling him that she is not at rest, and that a great coming disaster is causing animals and people to become violent, and to seek out her prior bandmates in order to piece together the symphony that will set her soul at east.

So obviously Karl has to do this right?

So Karl tells this to his dad and they leave home on an EPIC QUEST.

So they go to six different cities in Appleland, piecing together this musical piece.

Fighting rabid raccoons, turtles, ferrets, you know... 

They're joined by a gorilla named KOKO and a young orphan girl named LENA.

They keep fighting weird stuff.

And then after 3 hours of grinding across plot holes, poorly drawn enemies, and listening to a MIDI version of Darude's Sandstorm as the OVERWORLD and BATTLE theme, they finally piece together the symphony, bringing peace to his mother's soul. [/i]

So I let my friends play it...and they didn't like it as much as I did...

But looking back I don't blame them because I just don't think the game made sense to them.

Good stuff, good memories.

Thanks for listening to the story of [i]Unburied[/i] and HAPPY RPG MAKER DAY!
If you're ever looking for a creative outlet I'll always personally suggest trying out 
RPG MAKER MV.

Much Love,

-FrostedFears

notes.title: The Fool Class Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[h1]It's about dang time huh?[/h1]

But that's not all in this update!

So the Fool class is now available to play!
You'll enjoy her unique and quirky abilities as they're a hybrid of both melee and magic
based classes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/e232c320cc5f33557a610269ce85a9c8fe5018c2.png[/img]

The Fool is the perfect class to replay through the main story of Happy Bones just in time to get hype for the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727860/Happy_Bones_Infernal/]Happy Bones Infernal[/url] !

[h2]The Trailer is also now available for your viewing pelasure![/h2]

So much like many of you, I've played through Happy Bones as pretty much every class several times now, and after the last update I received a lot of great feedback and ideas that during my most recent runs I've decided to implement.

So major changes:

[h2]NEW WEAPONS WITH UNIQUE ANIMATIONS HAVE BEEN ADDED! WOOOOO!
They've been added to random enemy drops throughout the game![/h2]

Here's just a few of them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/0cf6427aa13def23d238043fc8871e2f1b739aeb.png[/img]

[h2]NEW PINS ADDED TO THE PRIZE CAPSULE POOL! WOOOO![/h2]


[u]The Burglar is now able to equip any weapon in the game[/u] after several bugs locking it to the Switchblade and thence locking out the Weapon slot, that being said the Switchblade is still one of the best choices for that particular class as it can be upgraded and has a fantastic critical rate, but now if you desire to equip a Dead Fish as a Burglar, you go right ahead!

Also, I can't divulge any details yet but Happy Bones will be featured in a celebration mid-February, and on during the celebration I'll be releasing a special item code for a VERY. SPECIAL. WEAPON.
You'll like it, trust me.

Thank you all for your continued support throughout the first year of Happy Bones' release, as well as your support for the upcoming Happy Bones Infernal!

So I have some questions for you all...

Firstly, if there's another big DLC update to Happy Bones, what would you like to see in it?
(Besides the Funhouse)

Secondly, in the future if I were to make another RPG that wasn't horror themed, what would you like to see as far as that goes? 

Talk to me friends :)

As always, thank you for playing!

notes.title: HAPPY BONES INFERNAL DETAILS REVEAL!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the Happy Bones Infernal Details Reveal![/h1]
[h2]What it is, what it's all about, what to expect![/h2]
[h3]You're going to like it, promise.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/fdeabb199f6275dec9c6b31e0d5989c35241fa18.png[/img]


So it's been a hot minute since we talked about the next installment in the Happy Bones series, as I was focusing on the DLC for Happy Bones(1) and making sure your experience with that was as fantastic as it could be!
I'm happy to say that from your responses it seems that you've enjoyed it so far and that is the greatest holiday gift that I could ever possibly receive!
So now we get to have some fun and talk about where we're going next!

I wasn't sure quite where to start with this whole ordeal, but thankfully the lot of you have asked me more than enough questions about it so I'm going to just knock out some FAQ's in an order that makes sense :)!

[h3]So let's have at it![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/a84ddd1f42a42825f17fc5258349a980ee43965d.png[/img]

Happy Bones Infernal is a direct sequel of the first game so far as events are concerned, so Laura will be off doing what she was doing at the end of the first game.

[i]That being said...[/i]

If you never played the first game, this is a great starting point as you won't have to have beaten the first game to understand what's going on in Happy Bones Infernal.
The story in Infernal stands alone while also building on the foundation of the first game and it's DLC!

So to put it simply: 
If you haven't played the first Happy Bones, you're still going to love Happy Bones Infernal. 
And if you did play the first Happy Bones, you're going to go nuts over some familiar sights found in Infernal.

Happy Bones Infernal will [i]mostly[/i] follow a new group of characters!

Time to formally introduce Infernal's leading protagonist:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/6f8593a2f947c1c528ab1e20fe111a5ffdb41806.png[/img]

[h3]Whoops, sorry!

Roan wasn't quite ready for his grand reveal...

Let's get him changed into something a little more appropriate...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/fbd7b2a27d3d89449c4c68e2e301cd9eea4534a4.png[/img]

[h3]Much better![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/73aeddda2aa19876ba4821e3619afe74317d8491.png[/img]

[h3]CALM DOWN CORPSE HYDRA HEAD C, GIVE ME A CHANCE TO EXPLAIN HERE.[/h3]

Roan is a young man who is involved in a criminal incident returning home one day, while he essentially does the right thing, he's found guilty by the justice system.
Due to his affluent upbringing his father is able to pull some strings so he doesn't go to prison and instead is sent to an experimental reform academy for adults.

Which becomes the setting that we'll find ourselves in when playing this particular game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/44bf874240982738e8746c9f5baf77b9b3ddd649.png[/img]

I'd never forget about the rest of you!
You're what really set this game apart from the first one!

Naturally upon Roan's arrival at the academy he meets others that have been sent there for unsavory behavior, and quickly finds a common ground with them!

In Happy Bones(1), Laura was alone the entirety of the game.
Alone, outmatched, and outnumbered against many indescribable evils.
Solely to reunite with her parents and find out what was truly going on.

This playstyle clicked really well with players who wanted a simple RPG at face value, with
one character to really get invested in.

In Happy Bones Infernal you'll play as a group of people working together to survive, 
learning about each other's pasts, about each other's fears...
They argue, they fall in love, they grieve together.
You'll see human desperation unfolding before your eyes.
Infernal is a story of survival.
It's truly much more of a narrative experience than the first game could ever be.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/57f5127a5447371eb82cb0604f9f35ea9942d947.png[/img]

[h3]Well obviously the game looks a whole lot different than the top down 2D view of the first game.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/7cbad64f7f8f5bba9c8032402f67503b9915fed6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/1be0e3f927d56e500b5210ed590da8a1cb80f276.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/52e7c5edfcfa227fd184baa9ddcbb103fc904045.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/26641dbdf07ce188703814e3aac81ee24373dd68.png[/img]

Going 3D with this particular game really opened the doors to be able to provide player's looking for a game with exploration and puzzles a better experience than the first game.

Happy Bones(1) was unique in the fact that every screen was hand drawn.

While Happy Bones Infernal clearly can't take advantage of it's environments being hand drawn, it takes advantage of the new 3D space it finds itself in and turns it up to 11.

Compared to the first game, Infernal is absolutely massive.

The 3D environments are larger, more fleshed out, and generally provide a different experience than the first game.

[i]Climb a mountain, find a rift, go into the rift, climb another mountain, kill some demons, go explore the academy, walk through the woods, find some secrets.[/i]

There's a lot to see.

And if you're thinking you're going to miss all the cool spots from the first game...

[i]Maybe you won't have to worry about that ;)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/1b0f274fd92f85ca9d986dfffd5427617946c130.png[/img]

[h3]Along with new enemy's in general, comes a new enemy mechanic![/h3]

Shining enemies!

I know, I feel like we should be trying to capture them right?

For every single enemy in the game there is a shiny variant that has a 10% chance to appear instead of the standard one.
Not only do they look different, but they pack a serious punch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/b7b89a8f1e2418c532efbbc73ab3f1e8330e6797.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/0f11bce65b743c1c06b973951a9d9725006b1331.png[/img]

[h3]You can generally expect a shining enemy to have the following:

- 3 x HP
- Increased critical hit ratio
- Higher defense
- Expanded ability pool
- Higher block ratio
- 3 x Coins dropped
- 3 x Rare loot dropped
- 3 x Exp gained
- Drops a shiny coin![/h3]

[i]Shiny coins can be used to open some secret passages throughout the game.[/i]

Of course you always have the option to just run away from a shining enemy, but why would you ever want to do that?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/e9ff338f4739e1384df593cd4c717f4cf61d0b2e.png[/img]

[h3]"Didn't we already have achievements?"[/h3]

Steam Achievements were in the first game, in Happy Bones Infernal there is an in-game achievement system that works the same way, you do something cool, you get an achievement ribbon for it like the one's seen above!
You'll also be able to look at them all in a nice collection!
This will ensure that those who are playing on a system or console that doesn't support achievements will still get the same instant satisfaction and serotonin rush that the rest of us get :)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/cc78c6686cd126595f0120b73754779030165b75.png[/img]

[h3]Aah, I see you're a man of class as well Axe Demon, I too have been charmed by the allure of the Devourer's large luscious tongue.[/h3]

[h3]But...NO.[/h3]

The relationship system adds just another level of replayability to the game!

At the end of each Chapter (There's 8) you'll be able to choose a character to spend extra time with.
This increases your bond with that character, and grants Roan a skill or an item specific to that chapter and that character.

[i]Yeah, it's pretty deep.[/i]

For instance if you choose to spend time with Hilda at the end of Chapter 1, Roan obtains the skill 'Hilda's Favor' which  is a self-heal that is based off his attack power.
Whereas if you spend time with Izz at the end of Chapter 1, Roan obtains the 'Stunner' skill, a strike with a chance to stun.

Both are beneficial, and only one can be chosen per playthough.

It's truly up to you, I'm not going to go into too much detail on this because there's a lot of really fun sequences that I would rather be a surprise for all of you!

Maybe you want to perform what I call an "Antisocial Playthrough" which is where instead of spending time with anyone every night you just instead go to bed.

Seriously, it's an option!

Going to bed raises Roan's Max HP by +25 every time you do it, so you stand to have an extra +200 Max HP by the end of the game if you did that, but then you'd miss out on all the awesome dialog and event flags that come from spending time with a character.

Play your cards right and you even have the option to romance some of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/39a8dbaf896228b2eb500388cf0ae83ea13890a3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/890368dbae4aefd0c9280810d84ba901115457f7.png[/img]

[h3]I'm glad you asked![/h3]

So I'm sure a bunch of you will be happy to know that Lady Luck is returning, as are slot machines!
This time around they've been considerably improved and are more exciting as you get some reel-spinning action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/8f6e57986e38490d495877d4c286672ee60d83f3.gif[/img]

There's a new mini-game called [i]Three Card Monte[/i] where you have a chance to choose the Queen from 3 face-down cards in order to win Coins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/fdd7b56ae7cc329bc4b1967715c27eb7118db503.gif[/img]

[h3]And...Trading Cards![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/5c7dbeda9da5c5524954787a236119999208d697.gif[/img]

You'll have a book where you can see all the trading cards you've collected, and you always have the option to look at the ones you've collected in your inventory!
You'll notice that one shown in the .gif there is illustrated by this community's very own [i]Gatosa![/i]

This is my way of celebrating you all!

[h2]If you do fan art and post it in the Happy Bones community page between now and February 1st, 2022, I will absolutely make it into an in-game trading card![/h2]

They're nothing super crazy, just another thing for you to collect in-game if you'd like, they feature artwork or fan art, a title of the piece, a description or lore moment, and the illustrator :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/bfd256cb78ec1e0a7f9120ac61445469d0a44b29.png[/img]

[h2]I think that's about all I can type for this evening, this has been just a brief and small taste of what's to come in Happy Bones Infernal![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/af352fb8edbc8ec72f3972669f0ba86e5ec33e60.png[/img]

[h2]So pushy Spiderling, so pushy.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/92db57b7535f38c37ae24f47a016742a674036e0.png[/img]

[h2]There you have it folks, due out early next year...Happy Bones Inferal![/h2]

[h2]Expect a trailer in the near future![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/9e875ba6a786d64a1212449a607effa75281d3f0.png[/img]

notes.title: EPISODE: ALPHA DLC NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Bones first DLC update is now live![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/3d7fb8f95a0ad2a77aa66dab87cad65e1cb95dc2.png[/img]

[i]DLC live for users on Windows, update will come to Mac at a later date.[/i]

Once your game updates you can play through the Episode: Alpha DLC! 
The DLC follows Collette, a brand new character that was sent to infiltrate the compound!
It takes place chronologically right after the fight with the final boss of Happy Bones.

It's considerably harder than the standard game, as you'll need to conserve
throughout the entirety of it in order to make it to the end!
Choose when to use your Grenades and Medkits wisely!

As always, there's tons of secrets to find and 5 brand new achievements!

When you complete Episode: Alpha you'll get to start a new file of the Standard Game with a special item only found by completing the DLC, the 'Jailer's Whip' complete with it's own special animation!

Yeah, so that's another thing!

[b]If you haven't seen the new trailer yet, every weapon in the game has it's own animation[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/23acfbd8421b8167bebb80072fc1ed38b3307061.gif[/img]

So now you can beat down even the most mundane enemies in style!

Now let's talk about reworks!

So I received a number of comments saying that the game was too easy, and the ability to dual wield was too overpowered.

Well that's been reworked in a much more interesting way!

[h2]The Collectable Pins![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/8f7ef0e6725d5bafd7637756914da6688569617e.png[/img]

In the game room you'll now find a Prize Capsule Machine!

You'll insert 300 coins and after a short animation you'll get a prize capsule!

Upon opening the prize capsule you'll get one of 20 Collectable Pins, they all have their own unique effects, from restoring HP, to adding poison to attacks, I believe it's a solid way to make the game SLIGHTLY harder and considerably more interesting!

[i]Even the burglar class gets to equip the new capsules![/i]

So what now? 

What comes next after this DLC?

Well, there's still more coming, I'm still working on the new class and had originally planned to include that in this update but instead decided to focus on the new Episode and the new animations.

I've actually got a couple of different ideas for the next update, I don't want to make too many changes to the base game besides the addition of the new class but I can certainly see a new DLC Episode being added!

I'll update you all as it comes!

As always, Thank you so very much for playing!

And please Enjoy Episode Alpha!

P.S.

[h1]HAPPY FREAKING HALLOWEEN 2021!!!!![/h1]

notes.title: HAPPY BONES DLC COMING!
notes.content:
[h2]I bet y'all didn't see that coming.[/h2]

Surprise!

I've received a ton of feedback from players regarding what they would like to see in the game,
and I've listened!

[b]Happy Bones will receive it's first FREE DLC on October 22nd, 2021! [/b]
[i]Just in time for Halloween!
Yeah, I planned that.[/i]

[i]So what exactly is this DLC?[/i]

A lot of new content will be coming, most notably will be the inclusion of an entire new story episode that will be available to play...

[b]Happy Bones: Episode Alpha[/b]

[i]The episode will be able to be played standalone from a new menu that will appear when starting a new game, as seen below.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/3d7fb8f95a0ad2a77aa66dab87cad65e1cb95dc2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/e2d1fcba75927efe132935dad8185fc7a86ab1f5.png[/img]

Episode Alpha takes place immediately following the events of the base game, and will follow a brand new character: Colette Tumbler.
Colette is an agent that was hired to investigate several disappearances of children inside 'The Family' compound, she was actually referenced to in some text in the base game!
She wakes up in a closet she was hiding out in during the events of the base game after something very large crashes to the ground outside. [i]hint hint[/i]
She will play completely differently from Laura and any of her classes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/e0f5f4aac5a3eb427a3d0508c87b723b778a6825.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/671ac0287bc264718200b7fa4073f0e3aec8f0ca.gif[/img]

Colette is just a standard human, she has no special powers or anything so she relies on her trusty handgun and other gadgets in order to get the job done.

But... she only has a limited amount.

In Episode Alpha you'll have to conserve healing supplies and ammunition as much as possible in order to make it out alive.
There will be no vendors, very few drops, just whatever you can find between the beginning and the end.
Episode Alpha will be a true survival horror experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/3d0b7472d24888e0931123d870cbc79006955ab5.png[/img]

With new environments, expanded story, different gameplay, and new enemies, it will be a great addition that I believe you will all be able to look forward to!

Also if you haven't yet, go check out the store page for Happy Bones Infernal (Coming 2022)
and go ahead and wishlist that hushpuppy! :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727860/Happy_Bones_Infernal/

So what do you think?

Let me know in the comments!

And as always, thank you for playing!

notes.title: Update 3/30/21
notes.content:
So after Happy Bones was finished and having play tested it so many times, I began thinking to myself
what I could do to make the game even more interesting.
I had a lot of options but a few weeks back I was thinking about what I liked about other RPG's with this particular front-view battle style.
Then I was like "Yo, what if these enemies moved? What if they growled at the screen and the maggots squirmed and stuff?"
And we were off.
I began adding basic 3-5 frame animations for most of the enemies in the game, so when you get into a fight with any of them they have a little more life now and I've gotten a lot of awesome feedback on it!

That being said...

Not all of the enemies will likely have animations upon the game being launched, it was a late game development decision but I'm certainly dedicated to getting it done over the course of a few updates.

So here's a few .gif loops below of some enemies and how they look when you encounter them in battle!
They certainly add a little extra flare to the encounter :)
Hope you like them and look forward to you seeing them in game in a few weeks ːojseagullː

notes.title: UPDATE 1/25/21
notes.content:
Hey there!

I hope your day is treating you well, and if it isn't I do certainly hope that you're taking steps
to make it as fruitful as you can!

Anyways I figured I'd take a moment to talk about... [b]CLASSES![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/b395776ec8aa9cb19d5b7a8b2c150ab0fb22e245.png[/img]

As mentioned in the description on the store page, there's 3 classes!

The Occult, the Brave, and the Holy!

So what's the difference and what does it matter?

Every class will play the game a bit differently, in this game they even have class specific events!
For example the Brave class is able to smash rocks and get past barriers that the Occult and Holy
classes are not able to, usually leading to useful items and shortcuts!

That being said, the Occult can befriend enemies that would normally attack the other two classes, 
and receive gifts from them!

While Holy has an aura that instantly damages some Occult enemies upon entering battle, among 
other things!

Of course there's stat differences as well, Brave is a very bulky class that can take and deal a lot
of physical hits but will take high damage when hit with magic, etc.

Check out the breakdown taken straight from the class select screen below!
